{{Quote|I am told that a technician named Taln Solwind can aid me in contacting the Rebel Alliance. Will you deliver a message to this agent for me?|Ikka Gesul|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Taln Solwind''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] by the name of [[Ikka Gesul]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering a message to Solwind outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Despite being ambushed by two thugs, the spacer succeeded in doing so.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TechnicianTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Taln Solwind]]
Taln Solwind was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Because Taln Solwind spawned under a generic template, his appearance was randomized, and may have included a variety of different [[Species/Legends|species]] under either gender. While the [[canon]]ical species of Solwind cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity, the quest dialogue identified him as a male.<ref name="AED" />
